name: DEEP IN HELL
source:
The visual interactive novel about a detective who plunges deeper and deeper into the hell while investigating a murder.

Senior Hell Detective Harry is in a hell of trouble. Someone really important was murdered and he better dig deep to find out who did that or the apocalypse would seem like a kids party.

[From [url=https://uvst.itch.io/deep-in-hell]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部视觉互动小说，讲述一名侦探在调查一桩谋杀案时，在地狱中越陷越深的故事。

高级地狱侦探哈利遇到了麻烦。某个真正重要的人被谋杀了，他最好深入挖掘，找出是谁干的，否则末日就像一场儿童派对。

[来自[url=https://uvst.itch.io/deep-in-hell]Itch.io[/url]]
